prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Columbus after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Columbus Ohio for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — I just need one quick clarification before giving specific names: do you mean Columbus, Ohio? And can you tell me your ZIP or neighborhood (or whether you prefer a big national firm vs. a smaller local firm)?

I don't have live web access from here, so I can’t pull current phone numbers or the very latest reviews. What I can do right now is:

- Give a short list of the most useful places to call immediately (including a well-known national firm with a Columbus office and the Columbus Bar Association referral line).
- Give a checklist to use to quickly screen any firms you call.
- Give a short phone script and the key questions to ask during a free consultation (so you get the information that matters).
- If you share your ZIP or neighborhood, I’ll recommend 4–6 specific Columbus-area personal injury firms I know have handled car-accident cases (and explain why to call each), based on firm type, experience, and common strengths — and tell you how to verify their recent results/reviews.

Immediate places to call now
- Columbus Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service — good for vetted local attorneys who handle car-accident PI.
- Morgan & Morgan (national plaintiff personal-injury firm with a Columbus presence) — typically handles auto-accident cases on contingency, large client base, resources to handle serious injury claims and litigation.

How to pick 3–5 firms to call (quick checklist)
- Do they handle automobile/personal injury cases regularly (not just a general practice)?
- Do they take cases on contingency (you pay only if they recover)?
- Do they have trial experience and/or known verdicts/settlements for car-accident injuries?
- Will the lawyer who talks to you actually handle your case (or will it be handed to a junior associate/call center)?
- Do they have experience dealing with your injury type (soft-tissue vs. catastrophic, spinal, head injury)?
- How are their reviews and any disciplinary history (check state bar)?
- Do they advance medical expenses / work with medical liens if you can’t pay treatment up front?

Phone script + key questions (use in the free consult)
Intro: “Hi — I was in a car accident on [date]. I’d like a free consultation about a personal injury claim. Can you tell me if you handle car-accident cases and whether you take them on contingency?”
Key questions:
1. Do you handle car-accident personal injury cases regularly? Who would be my main contact?
2. Do you work on contingency? What percentage and are there any additional fees (court costs, expert fees)?
3. Have you handled cases with injuries like mine? Any recent settlements/verdicts you can summarize?
4. Do you take cases to trial if needed?
5. Will you advance medical bills or work with providers on lien until settlement?
6. What is your estimate of how long my case might take and possible next steps?
7. What information/documents should I bring to the next meeting?

What to bring to the consultation
- Police report number, insurance info for all vehicles, photos of damage/injuries, medical records or doctor contact info, names and contact info for witnesses, timeline of the crash.

If you want specific local firms
Tell me your ZIP or neighborhood and whether you prefer a large firm or a smaller boutique firm that will give more personal attention. I’ll then recommend 4–6 Columbus-area personal-injury firms to call and explain why each one might be a fit for your case.
